decision.observation: 1:10am; the farmer stands to the left of the saloon at ~(0.49,0.37), on the grass strip beside the building. The door with bars is to the right at about (0.80,0.48). The road back to the farm leads left/west.
decision.hypothesis: With about 50 game-minutes left, there is no chance of reaching the farm on foot. The 2am collapse resets the farmer in the farmhouse anyway, so the remaining time is best spent moving west to avoid being wedged in the building.
decision.memory: Late-night wandering in town has gained nothing. The next day, start fresh: exit via the bottom notch, go to town by 9am, and buy seeds at Pierre's before 5pm.
